title: FreeCode settings.json
description: Project (.freecode/settings.json) and user (~/.freecode/settings.json) settings. Both scopes use this shape; project wins per key.

permissions.description: Per-rule allow/ask/deny. deny anywhere wins; scope does not break a tie within a tier.

hooks.description: Shell commands run at lifecycle points, keyed by event name.

memory.description: Persistent cross-session memory: extraction, retrieval judging, consolidation.

autoExtract.description: Mine finished turns for facts worth remembering.

extractEveryNRuns.description: How often extraction is even considered. Values < 1 are ignored.

retrievalJudge.description: Judge retrieved memories for relevance before injecting them. Fails closed.

autoConsolidate.description: One cheap merge pass per project per day. Merges only — never deletes.

consolidateMinSessions.description: Minimum sessions since the last run before consolidating again.

redirect.description: Trajectory redirection. Off by default; see specs/2026-08-26-trajectory-redirection.md.

maxPerRun.description: Redirections per run. 0 disables as surely as enabled: false.

signals.description: Harness signal gates. All off by default; see specs/2026-09-12-harness-bench.md. Env FREECODE_AUTO_POKE / FREECODE_CONFIDENCE_GATE / FREECODE_HILLCLIMB_GATE ("1"/"0") beats these.

autoPoke.description: Send a model that stopped with open todos back to work.

confidenceGate.description: Send a completion whose confidence jumped by `spike` or more in one call back to verify.

spike.description: Confidence rise, in points, that counts as a spike.

hillClimbGate.description: Ask for a reframe when a todo's hill-climbability is below `threshold`.

threshold.description: Hill-climbability below which a reframe is requested.

name.description: Unique within the event; also the merge key across scopes.

matcher.description: Tool-name pattern: *, exact, regex, or write|edit. Default: all tools.

if.description: Argument condition, Tool(pattern) — e.g. bash(git *), write(*.ts).

once.description: Parsed and stored, but NOT enforced — treat as reserved.
